description: Emails a non-clinical consultation request through the Cloudflare Email binding after the visitor explicitly confirms. If confirmed is not true, nothing is sent: re-confirm the details with the visitor and retry this call with confirmed set to true. Set dry_run to true to validate the input and return a preview of the email without sending it. Do not collect date of birth, insurance, or clinical information. Consultation requests are routed through Found For AI (foundforai.com), who will pass them to Goldsberry Orthodontics. The office then contacts the visitor to schedule.

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the visitor reviews and approves the details. If this is not true, nothing is sent: re-confirm with the visitor and retry the call.

dry_run.description: Optional. When true, validate the request and return a preview of the email that would be sent. No email is sent. Omit this field, or set it to false, to send a real consultation request.

note.description: Optional non-clinical scheduling note (500 characters or fewer).

preferred_contact_method.description: How the office should follow up.

name: submit_consultation
title: Submit consultation request
